title: DATESYTD for one date is January 1 to that date
query: EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE ( VAR R = DATESYTD ( 'Date'[Date] ) RETURN ROW ( "Min", MINX ( R, 'Date'[Date] ), "Max", MAXX ( R, 'Date'[Date] ), "Days", COUNTROWS ( R ), "Sales", CALCULATE ( [Sales], R ) ), 'Date'[Date] = DATE ( 2024, 3, 10 ) )

source.quote: Returns a set of dates in the year up to the last date visible in the filter context.
source.supports: DATESYTD goes from January 1 to the last visible date

source.quote: DATESYTD returns the dates from the first of January of the currently selected date

derivation: The only visible date is 2024-03-10, so the result is 2024-01-01 to 2024-03-10: 31 + 29 (leap February) + 10 = 70 days. Sales in that range: Jan 300 + Feb 700 + Mar 10 500 = 1500.
